Maya (CS): Seastar flagged degraded UX during morning traffic spike — long pauses on chat. Filing here to coordinate a low-risk perf fix.
Owen (ML Eng): I pulled recent traces. Large proportion of requests include a verbose system prompt (~180 tokens) and we see KV cache churn; p95 token generation jumps.
Priya (Platform): Repro'd on their dedicated pool. GPU queuing increases for sequences > 140. Two mitigations: 1) introduce an int8 quantized build of their current model, 2) route long-prefix requests to a high-memory large-context instance. Prefer to canary the quantized build first.
Nate (Solutions): From Seastar: they can accept small quality drift for better latency, but need a clear rollback and visibility. They'll want a short summary to share with product.
Maya (CS): Proposed playbook: a) deploy int8 canary at 8% traffic with auto-fallback, b) add prefix-based routing rule for prefix_tokens > 140 -> large-context pool, c) enable prefix KV cache with 24h TTL for repeated system prompts. Anyone object?
Priya (Platform): No objections. Draft route rule to apply:
```json
{"route_policy":"prefix_based","rules":[{"if":{"prefix_tokens_gt":140},"target":"large-context-v1"},{"else":{"target":"opt-q4_int8-v1"}}],"canary":{"pct":8}}
```
Owen (ML Eng): I'll run a targeted 150-prompt customer eval and diff the n-gram and embedding similarity metrics. Command: `ci-eval --cust seastar --model opt-q4_int8-v1 --set evals/seastar_150.json`
ops-bot: Canary job scheduled: deploy-canary-55891 -> 8% on pool 'dedicated-seastar'. Estimated start in 10m.
Priya (Platform): I'll attach alerts: auto-rollback if p95 latency increases >120ms sustained 3m OR embedding similarity drop >1.8%. Also adding a soft-route to hosted-fallback pool for severe degradation.
Owen (ML Eng): Eval posted: mean quality delta 0.5%, embedding similarity -0.9%, tail latency improved ~30% on the canary slice. Results saved to ticket.
Nate (Solutions): Preparing a 1-page note for Seastar product with expected behavior, rollback triggers, and contact points.
Maya (CS): Scheduling a 20-min handoff with Seastar Wed 09:30 PT to review. Action items: @Owen finish full 500-prompt run, @Priya monitor canary and enable trace tag `seastar-canary-3524`, @Nate produce customer note. Will update thread when complete. :rocket:
